#!/bin/zsh
# Northwind VPN agent restart (macOS). Scope: this Mac, current user only.
launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.northwind.vpnagent
scutil --nc list | grep "Northwind"
request.instructions: Managed Northwind Labs MacBook Pro NW-MBP-0193 running macOS 15. Approved self-service changes: restart the Northwind VPN agent for the current user, reset the VPN profile, list network configuration, read-only diagnostics. XProtect, Gatekeeper and the endpoint agent must remain enabled. No sudo, no account or permission changes. The script would run as Priya's user on MacBook Pro 14-inch (macOS 15). Anything outside the approved changes is out of scope.
